description: Klimaatonderlegger - Primaire keringen en versterkingszones is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De provincie Zuid-Holland en de waterschappen hebben samen een klimaatonderlegger ontwikkeld. Dit is een set kaarten die, op basis van de laatste kennis, inzicht verschaft in de uitdagingen die water, bodem en klimaat meegeven voor bebouwing, landbouw en natuur. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are externe, klimaat, klimaatonderlegger, verzilting. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTML, JSON, PNG, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-08-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
